methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.

allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.

actual_scope: Implement denominator-aware early termination in the actual PR3709 fixed-tape Machin setup; prove directed interval containment and quantify the removed divisions and measured physical operations.
scope_change_reason: An originally posed precision/tape implementation step, with exact operation savings as the deliverable rather than a claimed wall-time replay speedup. It changes summation termination, not the prior outer convolution permutation refinement.
bottleneck_link: A source-specific reduction in paid encoded coefficient preparation under the retained precision/tape obligation. It is a constant-factor local construction improvement; it does not change the complex recursive supplier or kappa.
stop_rule: Ship the first exact division/resource improvement with interval containment and fixed-pool restoration; do not extend to a new root producer or another consumer.
evidence: Written all-precision containment and strict division-saving proof; independent rational interval corroboration, physical pi traces and complete twiddle packet comparisons; generated hash-bound receipts. Hosted CI is separate.
